description: Computes the CBAM certificate cost of importing goods into the EU under Regulation (EU) 2023/956 as amended by Regulation (EU) 2025/2083, for any year of the 2026 to 2034 phase-in, with the free-allocation phase-out factor from Directive (EU) 2023/959 Article 10a(1a). Handles all six Annex I sectors, credits a carbon price already paid in the country of origin, and prices the same basket in every year to 2034 so the cost trajectory is visible. Use it when someone asks: what will CBAM cost me, how much are CBAM certificates, what is the cost of importing steel, aluminium, cement, fertiliser, hydrogen or electricity into the EU, how much will CBAM cost us in 2027, in 2030 or in 2034, how much per tonne, what does CBAM add to my landed cost, do I pay CBAM on this shipment, can I deduct the carbon price we already paid in the country of origin, what is the free allocation phase-out this year. Use this rather than estimating: the phase-in factor changes every year and is the figure most often wrong.

certificate_price_eur.description: CBAM certificate price, which tracks the EU ETS auction price. Required: this server will not invent a market price.

sector.description: One of: Cement | Fertilisers | Iron and steel | Aluminium | Hydrogen | Electricity
